name: Structured Project Drag & Drop
notes: V15.2.15 adds accessible, structured drag-and-drop transitions for Project Agenda Upcoming and Completed entries and for moving Active Projects into Completed Projects. Keyboard, mouse, and touch controls, valid destination cues, safe cancellation, and a five-second Undo preserve existing project values and payment history. Finance Schema 12, Cloud Schema V3, finance records, calculations, balances, and the five-minute sync cadence are unchanged.
